source_quotes: we allow a spot for jurisdiction where each instance can harden as they need
overlap_check: Built-in method_21 and method_34 cover jurisdiction sourcing and source maintenance; draft 12 says humans decide only for jurisdiction confirmations. None covers the per-instance policy, agreements or decision log. New.

payload.name: Jurisdiction Is a Per-Instance Policy With a Durable Record
payload.description: Each instance hardens as its own agreements require. The policy is versioned, outbound personal data waits for the operator's agreements, every decision is logged without content, and unknown jurisdiction is flagged rather than passed.

principles.name: Each instance decides
principles.description: Jurisdiction handling differs by instance, so it is a policy the operator edits, not a constant in code.

principles.name: Engineering input, not legal advice
principles.description: The system supports compliance work; it does not certify it.

heuristics.action: apply the shipped defaults and log the corruption; never open the gate
rebuild the call and step gate snapshots at once, not only on a timer

decision_rules.name: Policy is per instance and versioned
decision_rules.condition: jurisdiction handling must differ between instances
decision_rules.outcome: keep an editable policy whose every version is appended to a never-rotated history; ship defaults as content; share it only by explicit export, staging by the receiver and an explicit adopt

decision_rules.name: Agreements before outbound personal data
decision_rules.condition: personal data would go to an unverified or third-country destination
decision_rules.outcome: require the operator's acceptance of each requirement first, and state the deploy consequence that calls hold on first boot; nothing accepts consent automatically

decision_rules.name: Check in a fixed order
decision_rules.outcome: check enabled, destination region, region allowed, agreements, deterministic personal-data shapes with kinds recorded and never values, an optional yes or no vote by an in-region model, operator approvals by content hash, then the policy action

decision_rules.name: Unknown is flagged
decision_rules.condition: the instance region or a request's jurisdiction is unknown
decision_rules.outcome: apply the global rules only, mark the region unknown, follow the policy to await or block, and show it to the operator

decision_rules.name: Log every decision without content
decision_rules.outcome: append time, entry point, subject hash, region, policy and rule-set fingerprints, outcome and matched conditions; never the content; never rotate; rows that cannot be written stay queued and retry

decision_rules.name: Erasure is plan then apply
decision_rules.outcome: produce a read-only plan first; apply only with the confirm phrase, a minimum needle length and the erasure switch; rewrite atomically; record the needle hash only; list what it does not cover

decision_rules.name: Label and date the sources
decision_rules.outcome: mark the output as engineering input, cite the source, and verify dates and case numbers before relying on them
